newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambican police say robberies dramatically up.
newsitem.headline: Mozambican police say robberies dramatically up.

text.p: Mozambican police said on Wednesday that crime figures were up over the past year, with a dramatic increase in the number of armed robberies.
Nearly 22,000 crimes were reported in the past 12 months -- around 11 percent higher than in the previous year.
Armed robbery jumped by nearly 71 percent, according to the police statistics published by the national news agency.

Mozambique is awash with thousands of illegal weapons, including assault rifles, left over from a 16-year civil war between rebels and the formerly Marxist Frelimo government that took power on independence from Portugal in 1975.
